system.unexpected: Something unexpected happened on our side. Try again; if it keeps failing, share the reference below with your administrator.
system.not_found: This item no longer exists or was moved.
system.bad_request: The request was not valid. Refresh the page and try again.
system.internal: The server could not complete this request. Try again in a moment.
system.database_unavailable: The database is unreachable. Canopy will recover as soon as it is back.
system.database_not_configured: The database connection is not configured. Ask your administrator to set CANOPY_DATABASE_URL.
system.encryption_key_missing: Secret storage is not configured. Ask your administrator to set CANOPY_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
system.encryption_key_invalid: The encryption key is invalid. It must be 32 random bytes encoded in base64.
system.secret_undecryptable: A stored secret could not be read. It may have been encrypted with a key that is no longer configured.
system.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait {retryAfter, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} and try again.
system.engine_unavailable: The file engine is unreachable. Try again in a moment.
system.engine_key_missing: The file engine is not configured. Ask your administrator to set the engine keys.
system.maintenance: Canopy is under maintenance. Try again later.

settings.invalid_value: The value for “{key}” is not valid.
settings.locked_by_env: “{key}” is set by the {env} environment variable and cannot be changed here.
settings.local_only: “{key}” can only be changed from the local network.

auth.setup_already_done: Canopy is already set up. Sign in with an existing account.
auth.setup_not_local: The first administrator can only be created from the local network.
auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
auth.password_breached: This password appears in a public data breach. Choose another one.
auth.invalid_code: This code is not valid. Check your app's clock and try again.
auth.second_factor_expired: This sign-in took too long. Start again.
auth.cannot_revoke_current: Use “Sign out” in the account menu to end this session.
auth.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this. Ask an administrator for access.
auth.ip_blocked: Too many failed attempts from your network. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
auth.two_factor_required: One of your groups requires two-factor authentication, so it cannot be turned off.
auth.engine_token_missing: Your session could not be passed to the file engine. Reload the page.
auth.engine_token_invalid: Your session expired for the file engine. Reload the page.
auth.link_invalid: This link is invalid, already used or expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
auth.signed_out: Your session ended. Sign in again.

users.last_admin: Canopy needs at least one active administrator. Give another account the Admin role first.
users.not_on_self: Manage your own account from the Account page.

access.built_in_role: Built-in roles can be edited but not deleted.

files.forbidden: You don't have access to this folder.
files.not_found: This item no longer exists or was moved.
files.not_a_directory: This is a file, not a folder.
files.exists: Something with this name already exists here.
files.invalid_name: This name is not allowed. Avoid slashes and keep it under 255 characters.
files.into_itself: A folder cannot be copied or moved into itself.
files.same_location: These items are already in this folder.
files.duplicate_names: Two selected items have the same name; they cannot go into the same folder.
files.no_space: There is not enough free space at the destination.
files.verify_failed: A copied file did not match the original, so the source was kept.
files.too_large: This file is larger than the administrator allows.
files.blocked_type: This type of file is not accepted here.
files.invalid_upload: This upload is not valid. Try again.
files.upload_not_found: This upload no longer exists. Start it again.
files.volume_protected: Top-level folders are mounted volumes and cannot be deleted.
files.no_preview: This file can't be previewed. Download it to open it.
files.not_archive: This file is not an archive Canopy can extract (zip, tar, tar.gz).
files.bad_archive: This archive is damaged or contains unsafe names, so nothing was extracted.
files.mixed_folders: Only items from the same folder can be compressed together.
files.archive_too_large: This archive would not fit: it expands beyond the free space or holds too many files.
files.host_denied: The server account Canopy runs as is not allowed to open this folder. Give it access on the host (for example by adding its group to the folder), then try again.
files.favorites_full: You have reached {max} favorites. Remove one first.
files.archive_encrypted: This archive is protected by a password. Extract it from Commands › Extract an archive (7-Zip), which asks for it.
files.sevenzip_unavailable: 7-Zip is not installed on this server, so this archive format is not available.
files.nothing_to_compress: Nothing to compress: the selection holds no file you may read.
files.volume_not_writable: Canopy cannot write to this volume. Ask your administrator to create a .canopy-uploads folder at its top, writable by Canopy.

mail.not_configured: Email is not configured. Set up SMTP in Administration › Email.
mail.auth_failed: The SMTP server rejected the username or password.
mail.connection_failed: Canopy could not reach the SMTP server. Check the host, port and encryption.
mail.invalid_recipient: The SMTP server refused the recipient address.
mail.tls_failed: The secure connection to the SMTP server failed. Try another encryption mode.
mail.send_failed: The email could not be sent.

jobs.too_many: You already have too many operations in progress. Wait for one to finish.
jobs.interrupted: The operation was interrupted because the file engine restarted.

trash.not_found: This item is no longer in the trash.

shares.exhausted: This link reached its download limit.
shares.password_required: A password is required for share links.
shares.expiry_too_long: Links can be valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} at most.
shares.type_not_allowed: This type of file is not accepted by this link.
shares.file_too_large: This file is larger than this link accepts.
shares.total_exceeded: This link cannot receive that much more.
shares.files_exceeded: This link cannot receive more files.
shares.upload_failed: The file could not be sent. Try again.
shares.identity_required: Tell who you are before sending files.
shares.identity_unavailable: This link cannot verify e-mails right now: ask the person who shared it.
shares.identity_needs_mail: Verifying depositors' e-mails needs e-mail to be set up.
shares.code_invalid: This code is not the right one.
shares.code_expired: This code no longer works: ask for a new one.

commands.unknown_param: This option does not exist for this command.
commands.invalid_value: One of the options has a value this command does not accept.
commands.unavailable: This command is not available (not installed, or advanced mode is off).
commands.failed: The command ended with an error. See its output.
commands.timeout: The command took too long and was stopped.

plugins.invalid_manifest: This release is not a valid Canopy plugin.
plugins.checksum_mismatch: The downloaded file does not match the release checksums. Nothing was installed.
plugins.unsupported_platform: This release has no build for this server.
plugins.github_unavailable: GitHub could not be reached. Try again later.
plugins.no_release: This repository has no published release.
plugins.incomplete_release: This release is missing a file Canopy needs.
plugins.repo_not_allowed: This repository is not in the allowed list.
plugins.invalid_repo: Enter a GitHub repository like owner/name or its address.
plugins.repo_already_allowed: This repository is already in the list.
plugins.invalid_saved_value: Give the value a name, and a value that does not start with a dash.
plugins.saved_values_full: This field already has 20 saved values. Forget one first.

media.busy: Too many videos are being converted right now. Try again in a moment.
media.unreadable: This video could not be read.
media.invalid_start: This position is outside the video.

devices.unknown_kind: This plugin does not provide this kind of device.
devices.detection_slow: The search is taking long: it goes on in Operations, try again in a moment.
devices.detection_failed: The search for devices failed: see its output in Operations.
devices.full: At most {max} devices of a kind are kept: forget some first.
devices.already_kept: This device is already in the list.
devices.not_found: This device is no longer in the list.
devices.no_pairing: This device cannot be paired from Canopy.
devices.pairing_failed: The pairing did not succeed: check the code and try again.
devices.no_control: This screen cannot be driven from Canopy.
